propositions: Event bodies bearing live credentials are accepted and persisted by the store with no write-time screening, allowing secrets to be published on auto-push and blocked by GitHub push protection, which wedges the shared tickets branch for all concurrent sessions

The write seam is not `append_event` alone; `inbound_translate` writes untrusted Jira-sourced COMMENT/EDIT bodies by calling `finalize_event` halves directly, bypassing `append_event`, creating a screening bypass

A deterministic secret pattern detector with fixed-width entropy window and line-anchored PEM patterns is enforced at `_seam.finalize_event` (the single convergence point for all writers including the reconciler); refused writes are loud, auditable, and leave the caller in control

Refusal on secret match does not echo the value to stderr, logs, exception messages, or disk; keys used as dict keys are redacted from the field path before printing; a tested positive control confirms the on-disk assertion works
An audited force override `--allow-secret-pattern=<reason>` records who forced and why on the event; it is CLI-only and absent from the MCP surface

False-positive rate measured against live store is one self-referential benign match (AWS doc example); benign look-alikes (truncated placeholders, regex literals, prose enumerating banners) all still write
